text.tspan: SALT: spectral-anchored lesion transformer on a VoComni-pretrained nnU-Net (no DCA / CFC)
CT intensities x (input of the image anchors)
one mask + one score per query
illustrative; anchors and |R| computed on it with the 2D analogue (σ = r/√2).
Lesion query decoder (LQD) and set loss
Train: Hungarian matching per layer to 26-conn. tumour components (≥ 20 vox);
FAF-3D: frequency-aware decoder fusion (at D2, D3, D4)
α, β = 0 at initialisation ⇒ identical to the pretrained decoder; k³ shifted views summed, memory O(|x|); 3D, gated form of FreqFusion (TPAMI 2024).
SMD: spectral moment descriptor of each query mask
Bars: values measured on soft ball / tube / sheet masks (experiments/test_salt.py).
